basic_info.description: Tucked away in a peaceful, landscaped courtyard, this thoughtfully updated one-bedroom condo offers comfort, convenience, and a touch of greenery just steps from the vibrant pulse of San Francisco. Inside, new flooring throughout adds warmth and a modern edge. The refreshed kitchen features new countertops and shaker-style cabinetry that blend form and function, perfect for cooking everyday meals from Whole Foods on Dolores or enjoying takeout from the nearby Valencia Corridor.    The updated bathroom features a clean, contemporary vanity. The spacious private balcony overlooking a quiet garden path offers the perfect spot for morning coffee or evening wind-down. A generous walk-in closet and ample storage complement the smart, efficient floor plan, making the most of every square foot.    The building offers a full suite of amenities:secure entry, elevator, dedicated and guest parking, bike storage, gym, sauna, laundry facilities, on-site management & even a conference room. An ideal home base for anyone who wants both tranquility & walkable city living.  Moments from Dolores Park, the Mission, and the Castro, you'll have easy access to Muni, BART, cafes & nightlife while feeling a world away from the city's bustl
